original_analysis: An explicitly abstract right-angle model separates median from mean; it is not actual generator output. For a fixed 32×32 independent texture drawn at 64×64, changing symmetric full range R=4 to R=8 while retaining old Q=8 makes the ideal straight-edge transition width 2 rather than 1 screen pixel, with center unchanged. No empirical blur ratio is claimed.
licensing_scope: Original explanatory prose and arithmetic; no complete implementation, font asset, source-code block or paper figure copied.
